creative_brief.source: article: AI agents are changing software development
creative_brief.thesis: The image is really about human craft collaborating with autonomous machine labor.
creative_brief.visual_metaphor: A marble sculptor-figure and a floating robotic arm co-carving a glowing blueprint-column of code
creative_brief.image_goal: Editorial hero communicating collaboration, not replacement

art_direction.historical_language: marble sculptor figure, copperplate engraving lines, classical column
art_direction.contemporary_language: robotic arm, glowing code blueprint, neural scaffolding
art_direction.medium: mixed-media editorial collage, copperplate etching plus screen print
art_direction.rendering_language: cross-hatched ink drawing with stippled marble shading and halftone code glow
art_direction.composition_language: B classical-figure-plus-modern-tech, asymmetric poster with large negative space right
art_direction.color_strategy: electric blue dominant bg, black-cream hero, acid yellow accent on code nodes
art_direction.texture_strategy: dense cross-hatching, stipple dots, halftone, paper grain, screen-print misregistration

visual_spec.hero_subject: life-size marble sculptor figure in engraved black-cream rendering, holding chisel to a half-marble half-glowing-code column
supporting_elements: articulated robotic arm mirroring the sculptor gesture
floating code glyphs and blueprint grid fragments
visual_spec.environment: saturated electric-blue void with faint classical entablature fragments
visual_spec.composition: Pattern B: hero left-of-center at 65% scale, robotic arm entering from top-right, negative blue space right for eye rest, eye path figure to column to arm
visual_spec.spatial_relationships: foreground sculptor, midground code-column, background faint entablature; arm overlaps column
visual_spec.perspective: slight low-angle editorial view, deep apparent focus
visual_spec.lighting: directional graphic light left, black ink shadow masses, symbolic glow from code nodes
visual_spec.color_hierarchy: saturated blue background, black-cream hero, acid-yellow accent nodes
visual_spec.atmosphere: dry print air, crisp graphic stillness

non_negotiables: old x new tension (sculptor x robotic arm)

prompt_strategy.reason: complex article needs spatial relations but stays efficient
prompt_strategy.model_specific_strategy: general: model-agnostic natural language, no vendor syntax

prompts.primary: Mixed-media editorial collage in antique copperplate etching plus modern screen print: a life-size marble sculptor figure rendered in black and cream cross-hatching co-carves a towering half-stone half-glowing-code column with an articulated robotic arm that mirrors his gesture, floating code glyphs and blueprint grid fragments orbiting the column, small laurel-wrapped laptop at the base. Saturated electric blue background with faint classical entablature fragments, asymmetric poster composition with hero left-of-center and generous blue negative space right. Black-cream hero against saturated ground with acid-yellow glowing nodes as single accent, dense cross-hatching, stipple dots, halftone, paper grain and slight misregistration, directional graphic light with ink shadow masses and symbolic code glow, deep focus, antique print reproduced through modern screen printing, intellectually curious and playfully absurd editorial mood, wordless.
prompts.compact: Engraved marble sculptor co-carving glowing code column with robot arm, electric-blue poster collage, black-cream hero, yellow accent, print texture.
prompts.model_specific: Mixed-media editorial collage, marble sculptor and robotic arm co-carving half-code column, copperplate etching and screen print, electric blue background, black-cream hero with acid-yellow accents, cross-hatching and halftone, asymmetric poster composition, curious playful mood.

negative_prompt.content: glossy CGI, stock photo, generic vector art, robot holding laptop cliche, bokeh, shallow depth of field, readable text, watermark
